name: Naia Slides
description: PDF·PPTX 발표, 특정 페이지 시작, 집중·전체 화면, 발표자 메모 접기, 나이아 창 MP4 녹화와 Workspace 재생을 지원하는 슬라이드 앱

descriptions.ko: PDF·PPTX 발표, 특정 페이지 시작, 집중·전체 화면, 발표자 메모 접기, 나이아 창 MP4 녹화와 Workspace 재생을 지원합니다. 녹화는 data-private/apps/land.naia.slides/video/에 저장됩니다.
descriptions.en: Present PDF and PPTX decks from any page in focus or full-screen mode, collapse presenter notes, record the Naia window to MP4, and open recordings in Workspace. Recordings are stored under data-private/apps/land.naia.slides/video/.

tools.name: skill_slide_presenter
tools.description: Control the active Slides app. It supports starting at a selected page, focus/full-screen presentation, collapsible notes, and MP4 recording of the Naia window saved in the app sandbox and opened in Workspace. Actions: start, pause, resume, stop, next, previous, goto, question, status, get_context.
